comment: The declared roster. Being listed here is NOT evidence that a worker exists.
Every entry is probed against the live system on each read; an entry whose
probe finds nothing is reported OFFLINE, which is the point of the file.
Optional `engineering_store`: the kernel's engineering/ directory (see product memory,
ENGINEERING_LIFECYCLE_PRODUCERS.md). When declared, the records decide a worker's status
and the probes only reconcile. Optional per-worker `principal_id` joins a worker to the
principal named in review dispatches; `probe.kind: records_only` declares a worker nothing
